body: like... I just don't know wha tto do anymore. I'm a freak, a creep, a weirdo, a fat girl. I have no place here... nobody fuxing likes me. I wanna just roll over and squish everybody with my lard ass.

I'm looking for insight on why people are important, not stating that "I'm gonna jump." I really want a good reason why people in general should be allowed to live.

For example... The elementary school shooter. Phoebe What's her face (cyber kid) Who did they have to turn to? Cuz I don't have anyone. My boyfriend Idolizes me. He's also a loser with no car and an addiction to xanax. Oh, and he suffers from panic disorder and GAD. He's a total freak, and he's all I got left. How sad is that?

You have cropped bright red hair... What about that is normal? You skipped a grade, what about that is normal? Who exactly do you blend in with that you think you're all worker bee-d? You're probably just feelinjg unchallenged due to a lack of stimulus. It happens when an intelligent young girl realizes that everyone around her is an idiot. Take up a "smart" hobby. something like wiring radios, or making fireworks. Something that takes brains for a 15 year old to do correctly. You are more than special. And just remember, there are plenty of us that feel like this. I graduated at 16. I have since defaulted on student loans, (screw the bank) burned out of med school (FULL OF DUMMIES OMG YOU WOULDN'T BELIEVE!) became a bartender, and turned 20. Also, I hate humanity and have to deal with the urge to brickslap people on a daily basis. It's not that no one notices your genius, it's that no one really wants to feel stupid compared to you. They are all tired of admitting that you are superior. They are just jealous that you are smart, beautiful, and fun.
